response.original_title: How Can I Change or Upgrade My Room on a Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: [Official Helpdesk] To change or upgrade your room on a Royal Caribbean cruise for a confirmed cabin number, call the Stateroom Upgrades Desk at 1-888-671-2793 before your sail date, because rooms are nearly 100% occupied onboard and the website only offers unconfirmed RoyalUp bids.  Verified Phone Line: 1-888-671-2793 (Confirmed Room Upgrades & Changes Desk).  Call 1-888-671-2793 directly: Provide your booking ID to pay the exact fare difference for a confirmed Ocean View, Balcony, or Suite upgrade.  Pick at 1-888-671-2793: Select your exact deck and mid-ship cabin number instead of gambling on a random auction room.  Cancel via 1-888-671-2793: Have the agent cancel any pending RoyalUp bids so your credit card is not charged twice.
